title: Update on Plans to Regulate Foreign Worker Dormitories under Foreign Employee Dormitories Act
what_it_is: Update on Plans to Regulate Foreign Worker Dormitories under Foreign Employee Dormitories Act

sections.label: Regulating foreign worker dormitories under FEDA
sections.summary: Plans to expand FEDA to regulate all dormitories, with implementation intended by the end of the year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether an update can be provided on the plans to regulate all foreign worker dormitories under the Foreign Employee Dormitories Act (FEDA); and (b) whether a timeline can be provided on when the FEDA will be amended.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: This will strengthen our regulatory levers to raise and enforce new standards quickly during pandemics and introduce a consistent regulatory framework for dormitories of different sizes and types.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: There are, currently, more than 1,000 of such smaller dormitories, including factory converted dormitories (FCDs), construction temporary quarters (CTQs), temporary occupation licence quarters (TOLQs) and non-government organisation (NGO) shelters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: The significant number of dormitory beds across this diverse range of dormitory housing types and the broad landscape of operators necessitate more time to engage these groups to better understand the infrastructure constraints and the impact of the licensing requirements, especially on our smaller dormitories.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: We intend to implement the expansion of FEDA by the end of the year and will share more details on the expansion in the coming months.

sections.label: Support for dormitory implementation
sections.summary: Sufficient time and a transition plan will be provided for dormitories to meet new requirements.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Two, what kind of support are we providing to the dormitories when it comes to implementation of these new rules?

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will, definitely, make sure there is sufficient time for this implementation and to develop a transition plan for the different dormitories to meet the new requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will share more details in the latter half of this year.
